categories_thin: Accounting / tax: only a handful of real CPA firms; most South Amboy tax listings are seasonal storefront preparers or chains, so the list is short relative to the population.
Insurance agencies: nearly every find was a brand-franchised agency (State Farm, etc.) that the brief excludes; only one clear independent agency surfaced.

Independent retail (hardware, appliances, bicycles, music, furniture beyond one store): the Broadway retail strip is thin — most retail is food, liquor, salons, or auto. No hardware, appliance, bike or music shop was found operating in town.

Manufacturing / warehousing: South Amboy's industrial land is largely big-box logistics real estate (Prologis, Dalfen) rather than identifiable independent manufacturers, so only a few named plants appear.

Tutoring / test prep / driving school: every tutoring center found was a national franchise (Mathnasium, JEI, Sylvan) located on Route 9 with a South Amboy mailing address, so none qualified; no driving school was found in town.
Medical: primary care, dental and physical therapy are present but the town has no independent multi-specialty group of size; most specialty care is in neighboring towns.
caveats: The city's official Business & Non-Profit Directory is the backbone of this list but shows signs of age (duplicate rows, businesses with no phone, an ice-cream truck with an out-of-town PO box). Treat single-directory entries as leads to be confirmed.

Several businesses carry a South Amboy (08879) mailing address but sit on Route 9 or Route 35 outside the municipality; these are flagged in the address/notes fields. 08879 also covers parts of Old Bridge and Aberdeen.

Excluded under the brief's rules: restaurants/cafes/bakeries/delis/pizzerias/ice-cream and food trucks (a large share of the city directory), liquor stores, groceries, pharmacies, banks (Amboy Bank, Provident, Wells Fargo, Santander), chains and franchises (Century 21 Charles Smith, Roto-Rooter, Merry Maids, SERVPRO, ServiceMaster, JAG Physical Therapy, Kessler, Planet Fitness, Mathnasium, JEI, DCH Auto Group, Home Depot, Knights Inn, Extra Space/Public Storage/SecureSpace), and fraternal/civic organizations (Elks, Knights of Columbus, Ancient Order of Hibernians).

Boundary calls included with a note rather than dropped: South Amboy YMCA, Acelero Learning, Venetian Care (Windsor Health), Horizon Termite Control, Go Go Car Wash, and the Vrola/Tidal Seafood food-processing plant.
Where a listing showed no street number or phone, the field says 'Unknown' rather than a guess; the triage team should confirm those before outreach.
Two directory rows sometimes describe one business (Broadway Barber House, Tanchyk DMD, Venetian Care, Vrola/Primal/Tidal). Each is entered once with both addresses in the address/notes fields.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap Overpass API timed out from this environment (twice), so no OSM-derived completeness cross-check was possible.

Yellow Pages, Superpages, BBB category pages, ChamberOfCommerce.com and hub.biz all returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks to both fetch and the real browser, so those bulk directories could not be mined.

Google Maps served a 'limited view' — about five results per query — so each category was only partially enumerated; additional trades (masonry, fencing, painting, siding specialists, moving companies, pet boarding) are likely undercounted.

The browser session hung partway through the Maps sweep (hair salon and insurance queries did not return), so salon and insurance coverage relies on the city directory and web search rather than map listings.
No South Amboy-specific chamber of commerce member directory exists online; the Old Bridge–Sayreville–South Amboy chamber has no public member list, so chamber members were not separately captured.
New Jersey business-license and registered-agent bulk data were not consulted; businesses operating in town without a storefront (home-based contractors, consultancies) are certainly undercounted.
